title: 3 Ways to Say "Yes" Like a Native Speaker #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Yes" in English. Don't just say "Yes". Here are three answers native speakers use:
• Sounds good. (to a plan)
• Count me in. (to join in)
• By all means. (to give permission)

Want 20 ways to say yes? Watch the full lesson on this channel: Other Ways to Say Yes in English: 20 Better Answers (With Examples)
